name: combobox-clear
title: Combobox clear
description: A combobox with a button that clears it.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { ComboboxClear, ComboboxContent, ComboboxControl, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxItemIndicator, ComboboxList, ComboboxTrigger, } from '@/ui/combobox/combobox'; import { NdCombobox as Combobox } from '@ndop/primitives/combobox'; /** * A combobox with a button that clears it, shown in place of the chevron * once there is something to clear. Escape clears it from the keyboard. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-combobox-clear', imports: [ Combobox, ComboboxClear, ComboboxContent, ComboboxControl, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxItemIndicator, ComboboxList, ComboboxTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `
No country found.
@for (name of countries; track name) {
{{ name }}
}
`, }) export class ComboboxClearExample { protected readonly country = signal('Cameroon'); protected readonly countries = [ 'Brazil', 'Cameroon', 'Canada', 'France', 'Japan', 'Nigeria', ]; }
